meta.source_file: TEJ 逐字稿資料庫 2026 年（台積電 20260716）

summary.text: 台積電第二季美元營收402億美元，位於財測高標，受AI需求帶動，HPC營收季增20%、占比66%。第三季營收財測446至458億美元，全年美元營收成長上修至略高於40%，資本預算上修至600至640億美元，並宣布追加亞利桑那投資。

outlook.text: 第三季營收指引446至458億美元，中值季增12%、年增37%，毛利率65%至67%。全年美元營收成長由前次的30%以上上修至略高於40%，資本預算由約560億美元上修至600至640億美元，並追加亞利桑那投資，未來三年資本支出將較過去三年更顯著提高。管理層表示AI需求強於先前預估、可延續至2029至2030年，A14維持2028年量產；消費性與價格敏感市場則因零組件漲價承壓，將審慎規劃。

items.quote: we expect our third quarter revenue to be between 44.6 billion and 45.8 billion US dollars, which represents a 12% sequential increase, or a 37% year-over-year increase at the midpoint.
gross margin is expected to be between 65% and 67%. Operating margin between 56% and 58%.
we now expect our full year 2026 revenue growth to be slightly above 40% year-over-year in US dollar terms.
we have decided to raise our full year 2026 capital budget to be between 60 and 64 billion US dollars

items.value: 先進製程 70–80%、特殊製程約 10%、封裝測試等 10–20%
items.quote: About 70% to 80% of the 2026 capital budget will be allocated for advanced process technologies. About 10% will be spent for specialty technologies, and about 10% to 20% will be spent for advanced packaging, testing, mask making, and others.

items.value: 較過去三年更顯著提高，未給數字
items.quote: We do not have a number to share with you.……the CapEx in the next three years will be even more significantly higher than the past three years.

items.value: 講稿稱 40 billion、Q&A 稱 100 billion，再建四座以上廠
items.quote: we would like to announce an additional 40 billion US dollar investment in Arizona.……we announce additional 100 billion investment in Arizona.……it probably additional four or more fabs will be built.
Risk production will start in 2027, and volume production is scheduled for 2028.
Both A13 and A12 are scheduled for volume production in 2029.
In 2026, they will receive 24 NT per share, up another 33% year-over-year, and we expect a continued and increasing cash dividend per share in 2027 as well.

items.value: 強於先前預估，未給新數字
items.quote: let me give you not a number, but it's stronger and stronger and stronger.……But stronger than what we said it before.

items.value: 強勁需求延續至 2029–2030 年
items.quote: I believe from this year all the way to probably 2029, 2030, the demand is very strong.

items.value: 零組件漲價與總經不確定，需求承壓
items.quote: we observe consumer and price-sensitive end-market segments are being challenged due to the impact of rising component prices and macroeconomic uncertainties.

conclusion.text: 成長動能幾乎全來自AI，管理層稱需求與供給缺口很大，先進封裝產能吃緊已限制客戶成長，因此大幅上修資本支出並加速台灣、美國、日本建廠。現金及有價證券達新台幣3.5兆元，股利持續調升。主要變數是消費性市場疲弱與設備漲價帶來的成本壓力。Q&A中對長期資本支出與AI成長率均不給具體數字。

growth.reason: 全年成長與資本支出同步上修

key_data.quote: We concluded our second quarter with revenue of US 40.2 billion, at the high end of our guidance in US dollar terms
2-nanometer process technology contributed 3% of wafer revenue in the second quarter.
Advanced technology, defined as 7-nanometer and below, accounted for 77% of wafer revenue.
HPC increased 20% quarter-over-quarter to account for 66% of our second quarter revenue.
We ended the second quarter with cash and marketable securities of 3.5 trillion NT, or 110 billion US dollars.
Inventory days increased 7 days to 87 days, primarily due to the ramp of N2 technology.
we generated about 783 billion NT in cash from operations, spent 496 billion in CapEx
In US dollar terms, our second quarter capital expenditures totaled 15.7 billion.
In 2025, we paid 467 billion NT in cash dividends, up 28.6% year-over-year

tone.note: Q&A較低多因「shortage」「inflation」等供給吃緊用詞。

qa.question: 能否提供2026至2028年的資本支出展望？
qa.answer: 不提供數字，但表示未來三年資本支出將比過去三年更顯著提高。
qa.quote: We do not have a number to share with you.……the CapEx in the next three years will be even more significantly higher than the past three years.

qa.question: 亞利桑那追加投資後的產能開出時程？
qa.answer: 時程視市場而定，預計再增建四座以上晶圓廠。
qa.quote: Sunny, the schedule will depend on the market situation.……it probably additional four or more fabs will be built.

qa.question: 三星與英特爾挾資源競爭，客戶會轉單嗎？
qa.answer: 強調技術、製造與客戶信任三大基本面，轉換代工夥伴沒有捷徑。
qa.quote: But the most important thing, as we continue to say, is the technology, manufacturing, and customer trust.

qa.question: 是否上修AI半導體的年複合成長率？
qa.answer: 不給新數字，但表示AI需求比先前所說的更強。
qa.quote: let me give you not a number, but it's stronger and stronger and stronger.……But stronger than what we said it before.

qa.question: 英特爾EMIB-T崛起，台積電如何因應？
qa.answer: 封裝產能吃緊已限制客戶成長，歡迎替代方案分擔負載、帶動前段晶圓業務。
qa.quote: Our packaging capacity is so tight that now it's limit my customers' growth. So we welcome that additional flexibility in the market.

qa.question: 若競爭對手新技術出問題，是否支援客戶？
qa.answer: 只重申以客戶成功為首要，能幫就會幫。
qa.quote: Our number one is to support our customers' success. So whatever that we can help our customer, the business, we will do it.

qa.question: 擴產規劃是否考量競爭與資料中心延遲？
qa.answer: 會考量競爭，並實地查核資料中心進度，確保晶片不會變成庫存。
qa.quote: So we actually we are checking the AI data center's progress, the building, the location, the demand, the racks.

qa.question: 明年底是否仍會供不應求？
qa.answer: 不做保證，但認為從今年到2029、2030年需求都會很強。
qa.quote: I believe from this year all the way to probably 2029, 2030, the demand is very strong.

qa.question: 記憶體毛利率更高，晶圓定價策略為何？
qa.answer: 不會大幅漲價，以合作夥伴角度確保毛利足以支撐長期擴產。
qa.quote: So we earn our value, and we make sure that our profit, our gross margin is enough for our long-term sustaining expansion.

qa.question: 前五大客戶集中度升高是否為風險？
qa.answer: 不擔心，客戶規模擴大是好事，AI產業也有很多新進者。
qa.quote: No, that's not our concern.

qa.question: 是否會投資或融資終端客戶？
qa.answer: 目前不做這類財務安排，現行合作模式運作順利。
qa.quote: So far, no, TSMC don't do this kind of financial arrangement

qa.question: 美國新增投資的時程規劃？
qa.answer: 有計畫但無確定時程，會依客戶需求盡快推進。
qa.quote: So, if you ask me to give you a firm schedule, no, we don't have it today. But we do have a plan.

qa.question: GPU、加速器與CPU的成長前景如何？
qa.answer: 不給具體數字，表示會與客戶協調CPU、GPU、XPU的晶圓配置。
qa.quote: We working with our customer to allocate the wafer, the supply, to balance the CPU, GPU, XPU ratio.

qa.question: 玻璃基板等新封裝技術進度？
qa.answer: 試產線建置中，約再一年成熟後可與客戶投入生產。
qa.quote: The progress, we're building a pilot line that I announced a few quarters ago. And it will take about another one year to be mature

qa.question: 能否量化未來幾年營收成長？需求動能為何？
qa.answer: 不給數字，只說未來幾年生意很好，需求全來自AI。
qa.quote: Next few years is going to be a very good business for TSMC, that what I can say.……It's all AI-related. Everything.

qa.question: 後段封裝競爭是否威脅前段晶圓業務？
qa.answer: 前段與後段是兩回事，歡迎競爭者為客戶提供彈性。
qa.quote: The front-end wafer business and the back-end business are two different things, right?

qa.question: High NA視場較小是否影響採用？
qa.answer: High NA是好工具，是否採用取決於成本與技術成熟度。
qa.quote: So we always consider that technology maturity and the cost and whether we use it or not.

qa.question: 先進製程供需缺口是否超過30%至50%？
qa.answer: 不給數字，但表示缺口非常大。
qa.quote: No, we don't have a number to share because of, let me say that, the gap is very big.

qa.question: 技術論壇公布的產能成長率是否改變？
qa.answer: 現在的產能成長比論壇當時公布的更大。
qa.quote: Oh, we showed the chart. Okay, now is bigger.

qa.question: 先進封裝占資本支出多少？會單獨揭露嗎？
qa.answer: 後段長期約占資本支出10%至20%，依瓶頸彈性調整，不細分揭露。
qa.quote: For long term, I mean that the back-end is about 10% to 20%.

qa.question: 年內兩度上修資本支出的原因？
qa.answer: 主因是需求持續增加，其次是設備價格上漲。
qa.quote: the most important reason is because of the demand continue to increase……The second reason is inflation. Now we buy the tools with inflation price.

qa.question: 成熟製程的供需與價格看法？
qa.answer: 只有AI相關的電源管理IC與感測器吃緊，其他消費性領域需求不強。
qa.quote: Only the one with related to AI is in shortage.
